NAME: GPIO verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-GPIO-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 Drive either pin high or low under firmware control.
details: Drive either pin high or low under firmware control.
implementation_note: Source: SYS §6.4

NAME: t_gpio_drive
details: Oracle: each pin drives high and low, independently
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, checks tagged [R-1] (lines 87, 90) - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-2 Read the level on either pin whether driven or not.
details: Read the level on either pin, whether driven or not.
implementation_note: Source: SYS §6.4

NAME: t_gpio_read
details: Oracle: PADIN follows an externally driven pin
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, check [R-2] PADIN follows an external driver on pin 1 (line 107) - 1 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_gpio_readback
details: Oracle: an output pin reads back the level it drives
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, checks tagged [R-2] output pin reads back (lines 97-100) - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-3 Per-pin direction control independently.
details: Per-pin direction control, independently.
implementation_note: Source: SYS §6.4

NAME: t_gpio_dir
details: Oracle: one pin output, one input, at the same time
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, check [R-3] (line 84) - 1 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-4 Word-only APB 32-bit registers at word-aligned offsets.
details: Word-only APB, 32-bit registers at word-aligned offsets.
implementation_note: Source: AHB2APB [N-7.12]

NAME: t_gpio_regs
details: Oracle: registers read back; PSLVERR on unmapped; [31:2] read 0
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, checks tagged [R-4], [N-6.2] and the ID read (lines 70-80) - 4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-5 Never stall the APB bus.
details: Never stall the APB bus.
implementation_note: Source: AHB2APB [N-7.15]

NAME: t_gpio_pready
details: Oracle: PREADY high in every cycle of every access
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, check [R-5] PREADY high in every cycle (line 185) - 1 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-6 One held level interrupt to CLIC ID 20 from a per-pin edge or ...
details: One held level interrupt to CLIC ID 20, from a per-pin edge or level condition.
implementation_note: Source: CLIC §7.2, D-17

NAME: t_gpio_irq
details: Oracle: rising-edge interrupt; held across 60 pclk though the IP pulses for 1; W1C drops it
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, checks [R-6] lines 121-127 and [N-7.3] W1C line 134 - 4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_gpio_irq_cause
details: Oracle: INTSTATUS names the pin and self-clears on read
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, checks [N-7.3] INTSTATUS names the pin and clears on read (line 137) - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_gpio_irq_masked
details: Oracle: an edge on a pin with INTEN clear raises nothing
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, check [R-6] INTEN clear raises nothing (line 151) - 1 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_gpio_irq_type
details: Oracle: falling, rising and either-edge each fire correctly
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, checks [R-6] falling-edge, either-edge (lines 161-175) - 4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-7 Pad inputs synchronised before use.
details: Pad inputs synchronised before use.
implementation_note: Source: D-14

NAME: t_gpio_sync
details: Oracle: an input change is seen, with synchroniser latency
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, check [R-7] input follows through the synchronisers (line 107-110); the latency itself is not measured - 1 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-8 Both pins released (inputs) from reset until firmware acts.
details: Both pins released (inputs) from reset until firmware acts.
implementation_note: Source: Board safety

NAME: t_gpio_reset
details: Oracle: both gpio_oe are 0 out of reset
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/gpio/tb_gpio.sv, checks tagged [R-8] (lines 64-67) - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_chip_gpio
details: Oracle: both pins from the core, through the real fabric
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: sw/chip/t_chip_periph.c step 2 (pin 0 driven high and low and read back through the pad, pin 1 input reads 0) and step 1 (ID); sim/chip_periph/run.log RESULT: PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression. Pin 1 is only read as an input, not driven.
